title: Old Fashioned Crunchy Russian White Bread Casserole
description: A rich and crunchy Russian dish featuring white bread mix, dehydrated to perfection, and plant-based friendly, this casserole is a cozy delight for any meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked mushroom and onion mixture, crushed white bread mix, crumbled tofu, vegetable broth, nutritional yeast, salt, black pepper, and dried thyme, and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the casserole rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
